BiblicalUsage: Battlements are the last thing taken from a city, and Jeremiah was told to take them away. Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy, but make not a full end, and take away her battlements, for they are not the LORD'S.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that battlements belong to the LORD, and when a city forgets it, the walls come down first.
